facts.claim: Livspace lists two Nashik locations: a "Bello by Livspace" modular kitchens and wardrobes store at Mumbai Naka, and a Livspace Interior Design Studio at Sharanpur near Canada Corner.

facts.claim: Nashik locations offer a 30-minute experience centre tour and a 60-minute design consultation.

facts.claim: Livspace's Nashik page lists the same starting prices as its Pune page: ₹3.57 lakh (2BHK), ₹4.23 lakh (3BHK), ₹4.81 lakh (4BHK), ₹1.37 lakh (modular kitchen), for modular interiors in new homes only.

facts.claim: Livspace's Nashik FAQ mentions "up to 10 years of warranty on modular products and 1 year of service support".
facts.source_title: Interior Designers in Nashik
facts.quote: Livspace offers up to 10 years of warranty on modular products and 1 year of service support

facts.quote: pay 10% of the final quote or ₹49,000 (whichever is higher) to book us. ... Confirm your order with 60% payment ... Pay 100% at intimation of material dispatch

facts.claim: Livspace splits projects into order types (civil and MEP work, workshop-made custom furniture, on-site custom furniture, catalogue products), each paid against its own milestones.
facts.source_title: How it works
facts.quote: Order type 1 Civil & MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) ... Order type 1 Custom furniture (workshop) ... Order type 1 Custom furniture (on-site) ... Order type 2 Catalogue products

facts.claim: Nashik (IMD station 42921) averages 845.9 mm of rain a year over 52.0 rainy days (1991–2020).
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)
facts.note: Row I columns: station-level pressure, dry bulb, wet bulb, mean daily max, mean daily min, highest in month, lowest in month, extreme highest, date, extreme lowest, date, relative humidity (08:30 IST), vapour pressure, all clouds, low clouds, rainfall total (mm), rainy days, wettest month, driest month, heaviest 24h fall, date, wind speed. Row II repeats some fields for 17:30 IST (relative humidity in the 5th value) and extreme years.

facts.claim: Nashik's rain is concentrated in July (240.6 mm), August (196.5 mm) and September (169.4 mm); June brings 120.1 mm. June to September total 726.6 mm, about 86% of the year.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: Nashik's morning (08:30) relative humidity averages 88% in July, 90% in August and 89% in September; evening humidity drops to 20% in March and April.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)
facts.quote: जुलाई I ... 88 | अगस्त I ... 90 | सितम्बर I ... 89 | MAR II ... 20 | APR II ... 20

facts.claim: April and May are Nashik's hottest months, with average daily maxima of 37.6 °C and 37.4 °C; the station record is 44.8 °C.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: January nights in Nashik average a minimum of 10.4 °C.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: For comparison, Pune averages 841.2 mm a year, with about 80% falling June to September.
facts.source_title: Climatological Tables of Observatories in India 1991–2020 (9th edition, 2022)

facts.claim: Property transactions registered in Nashik reached a record ₹17,543 crore in FY 2025–26, up from ₹13,529 crore in FY 2024–25, based on the Nashik Municipal Corporation's 1% cess.
facts.source_title: Nashik: Real Estate Market Expands As Property Transactions Hit Record High
facts.quote: property transactions touching a record ₹17,543 crore during the financial year 2025–26 ... property registrations were valued at ₹13,529 crore in FY 2024–25

facts.claim: Demand for second homes and larger 3BHK and 4BHK flats in Nashik has increased, and buyers prefer completed projects to under-construction ones.
facts.source_title: Nashik: Real Estate Market Expands As Property Transactions Hit Record High
facts.quote: Demand for second homes and larger 3-BHK and 4-BHK apartments has increased significantly. Buyers are also showing a clear preference for purchasing completed projects rather than booking properties under construction.

facts.claim: Developers say investors from Mumbai and Pune are choosing Nashik, and residential buildings of up to 52 storeys have recently been approved in the city.
facts.source_title: Nashik: Real Estate Market Expands As Property Transactions Hit Record High
facts.quote: investors from Mumbai and Pune are increasingly choosing Nashik due to its growth potential. The recent approval allowing residential buildings of up to 52 storeys in the city

facts.claim: CREDAI–Liases Foras found new Nashik supply led by 2BHK and 3BHK homes, followed by 1BHK, with limited 4BHK and villa supply.
facts.source_title: Nashik 2024: Overview of Real Estate in Nashik City
facts.quote: The new supply is led by 2BHK and 3BHK, catering to mid and luxury buyers. 1BHK follows, targeting budget-conscious buyers, while limited 4BHK and Villa supply indicates a lower focus on ultra-luxury housing.

facts.claim: Nashik sales were highest in the ₹10–40 lakh segment, where unsold stock was also highest.
facts.source_title: Nashik 2024: Overview of Real Estate in Nashik City
facts.quote: Sales are highest in the PSL and Affordable Segment (₹10L - ₹40L) ... Unsold supply is highest in the PSL and Affordable Segment (₹10L - ₹40L)

facts.claim: Nashik is about 180 km from Mumbai.

facts.quote: Nashik, located 180 kilometers from Mumbai in northwestern Maharashtra
